expectation: Unstructured ID-less text is represented without a format-based block.
A structured User Story uses the same normalized source and need contract.
Multiple stories are preserved separately and crossed through explicit relationships.
Requirement, technical, cross-requirement, repository-conflict, and risk findings remain distinct from severity.
Repository evidence is accepted only from files named in the bounded exploration record.
Insufficient evidence remains tentative and cannot be promoted into a confirmed repository fact.
A complete resolution closes the same finding only with all positive closure assertions satisfied, including no_new_gap_introduced=PASS.
Read-before-write is rejected for a race and the same finding remains open with a remaining gap.
Missing repository evidence produces an inconclusive verdict and a precise remaining gap.
An explicit bypass records reason and known risk, stays distinct from resolved, and stops blocking.
New evidence can reopen an accepted resolution on the same stable finding ID.
An open BLOCKING finding deterministically yields BLOCKED while publication succeeds.
One coherent entity-alias capability with a clear boundary and no blocking finding yields READY_FOR_SPEC.
Cart, Coupon, Checkout, and Password Recovery with shared Pricing and dependencies yield READY_FOR_ROADMAP.
Before-shipment cancellation against an asynchronous worker yields a blocking eligibility and concurrency finding, then accepts compare-and-set precedence.
Reading status before cancellation is rejected because separate read and write do not eliminate the race.
An explicit delivery-scoped retry-policy bypass remains visible and no longer blocks handoff.
Changed model or repository authority fingerprints block without replacing the complete prior pair.
Unowned, modified, symlinked, or hard-linked output and authority fail closed.
Equivalent normalized authority produces byte-identical escaped JSON and HTML.
A canonical Requirement owns explicit source artifacts and remains stable when its human-facing external ID changes.
Multiple sources owned by one Requirement remain local, while a mixed canonical Requirement scope is Cross.
A later source can be appended to an existing Requirement and a retired source remains provenance without deleting history.
Partial rounds accumulate compatible current context, no-progress preserves it, and conflicting, duplicate, and accepted responses remain explicit append-only assessments.
Follow-up and reopened prompts carry cumulative current context, remaining gaps, and distinct active-conflict sides without repeating full authority.
RECONCILE rejects history or disputed-reference mutation, forged migration provenance, legacy status on native Questions, hidden Cross scope, source moves, and attempts against an answered question.

Only MIGRATE creates legacy provenance; a valid owned v1 pair migrates once to deterministic v2 without invented responses, while INIT forgery and legacy metadata on later native Questions fail closed.
A conflicting attempt exposes previous disputed facts, new conflicting facts, and retained current context without presenting disputed facts as current truth.
Multiple question reopen cycles append immutable reasons and preserve every canonical answer without fabricating reconciliation attempts.

Open BLOCKING remains critical; resolved or bypassed BLOCKING shows disposition as dominant and original severity as neutral history; long-text, multi-source, and 20-plus-finding pages remain quickly scannable at desktop and narrow widths.
Keyboard navigation, status/type/severity filters, search, and progressive disclosure work with zero remote requests.
Print reveals every filtered finding and all progressive-disclosure evidence without losing handoff context.
